root_family.definition: Architectural building blueprints, structural engineering calculations, 3D visualization, soil geotechnical testing, and topographical surveying.

translations.am: አርክቴክቸር፣ የህንፃ ምህንድስና ፕላን እና የቅየሳ አገልግሎቶች
translations.ti: ኣርክቴክቸር፣ ናይ ህንጻ ፕላንን መሃንድስነትን ኣገልግሎት

children.definition: Municipality-approved architectural drawings, structural engineering detail drawings, and electrical/sanitary building schematics.

translations.am: የቤት ፕላን ዝግጅት እና የህንፃ ዲዛይን ስራዎች
